What one person has done, you can do too.

Kevin explains that every person was designed for accomplishment, engineered for success and born with the seeds of greatness. He speaks with real energy about it.

His point is that none of this has to be built from scratch. It is already there, and it only needs an awakening.

When did you last feel completely sure of yourself?

#ad #success #confidence #kevintrudeau

Your success formula is not the same as anyone else's.

Kevin explains that his mentor gave him a set of 40 points, and each one carries a numerical value. What matters a lot to you may matter little to someone else.

So every equation is customized. Kevin says that idea became the roadmap for the rest of his training on manifesting.

What matters most in your life that others might overlook?
